subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

On its last legs
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"On its last legs"** means something that is in a bad condition and likely to stop functioning soon. (बुरी स्थिति में होना और जल्द ही बंद होने की संभावना होना)

 
 
• **Example:** My old car is on its last legs; I need to buy a new one soon.
 
 
 
• **"In a bad condition"** refers to the state of being deteriorated or not functioning well. (खराब स्थिति में होना)
 
 
• **Example:** The house was in a bad condition and needed extensive repairs.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Slow movement** (धीमी गति): Moving at a low speed.

 
 
• **Example:** The turtle is known for its slow movement.
 
 
 
• **Creeping on legs** (पैरों पर रेंगना): Moving slowly and quietly close to the ground.
 
 
• **Example:** The spider was creeping on legs across the floor.
 
 
 
• **Last choice** (आखिरी विकल्प): The final option available.
 
 
• **Example:** Taking the bus was my last choice after my car broke down.
 
 

4e:Tafa,
The correct answer is '**make**'.
